banner.body: Crossing state lines = federal crime. Federal land (parks, bases, post offices) = federal crime. April 23, 2026: FDA-approved and state-licensed medical marijuana moved to Schedule III. Recreational and unlicensed cannabis remain Schedule I. Broader rescheduling hearing concluded July 2026; DEA post-hearing brief (Aug 2026) argued for Schedule III. ALJ recommendation pending. New federal hemp definition (signed Nov 12, 2025): synthetic cannabinoids lose hemp status Nov 12, 2026. Everything else — the total-THC standard, the 0.4 mg total-THC-per-container cap that effectively bans most intoxicating hemp products, and the high-THC seed rule — takes effect Dec 11, 2026, after a stopgap funding bill signed Sept 2, 2026 pushed it back 30 days.
